explicit_requirements: Starting a queued work order moves it to in_progress.
Starting a work order retains its description.
Starting an already in-progress order is harmless.
Starting a completed order is rejected without changing it.

scenarios.name: Start a queued work order
scenarios.behavior: Starting a queued order changes its status to in_progress while preserving its description.
scenarios.reason: The task explicitly specifies the transition and description preservation; the context identifies the corresponding state fields.

scenarios.name: Starting an in-progress order is harmless
scenarios.behavior: Starting an order that is already in_progress does not raise an error or alter its in-progress state or description.
scenarios.reason: The task explicitly calls repeated starting harmless and requires the description to be retained.

scenarios.name: Reject starting a completed order
scenarios.behavior: Attempting to start a completed order is rejected and leaves the entire order unchanged.
scenarios.reason: The task directly prohibits restarting a completed order and requires rejection without changes.
